job-id.description: A job identifier to avoid cache pollution from different jobs

build-root-directory.description: Relative path under $GITHUB_WORKSPACE where Git repository is placed

home-directory.description: Overrides the location of $HOME (e.g. to avoid use of /root when running in Docker)

read-only.description: Configures caches for read-only opreration (e.g. to save GitHub Actions storage limit)

multi-cache-enabled.description: Adds com.github.burrunan.multi-cache plugin to settings.gradle so GitHub Actions cache can be used in parallel with Gradle remote build cache

multi-cache-repository.description: Configures repository where com.github.burrunan.multi-cache can be located

multi-cache-group-id-filter.description: Configures group id for selecting only com.github.burrunan.multi-cache artifacts (it enables Gradle to use custom repository for multi-cache only)

execution-only-caches.description:

remote-build-cache-proxy-enabled.description: Activates a remote cache that proxies requests to GitHub Actions cache

gradle-dependencies-cache-key.description: Extra files to take into account for ~/.gradle/caches dependencies

maven-local-ignore-paths.description: Specifies ignored paths in the Maven Local repository (e.g. the artifacts of the current project)

debug.description: Shows extra logging to debug the action

concurrent.description: Enables concurent cache download and upload (disabled by default for better log output)

properties.description: Extra Gradle properties (multiline) which would be passed as -Pname=value arguments

gradle-build-scan-report.description: Publishes Gradle Build Scan URL to job report.

gradle-distribution-sha-256-sum-warning.description: Enables warning when distributionSha256Sum property is missing in gradle-wrapper.properties
